First Day at U.A..name: First Day at U.A.
First Day at U.A..description:
🏫 Day one of the Hero Course. You moved into Heights Alliance yesterday; this start opens the next morning with the walk into U.A., a classroom door taller than a house and a homeroom teacher with no patience for ceremonies.

📍 U.A. main building · first morning, the day after move-in
🎭 Tense, funny, high stakes
👥 For Hero Course students (Class 1-A or 1-B)
First Day at U.A..storyStart:
THE SITUATION: It is Monday morning, the first day of classes at U.A. Academy. The PC moved into Heights Alliance yesterday, Sunday, with every other first-year: room assignments, unpacking and the first night are over, and this is the first walk to class. The PC is a first-year in the Hero Course, in Class 1-A under Shota Aizawa or Class 1-B under Vlad King as their Path states: one extra student beside the canon classmates, who barely know each other yet. Homeroom starts at 8:30. Nothing has happened yet this year: no class has trained and nobody has been attacked. All Might joined the faculty this spring, and a few reporters wait outside the main gate in case he appears; they are behind the PC already. Vlad King means to take 1-B through the entrance ceremony. Shota Aizawa has no use for ceremonies: after roll call he will hand 1-A their gym uniforms, send them to the locker rooms to change and put them on the athletics field beside the main building to see what their Quirks can really do; how he runs it, what he threatens and what each student shows belong to play, not to this opening. Hero costumes are not handed out until All Might's first class on Tuesday.

THE PLACE: the player's homeroom in U.A.'s main building, reached through glass-and-steel corridors built for students of every size, with a classroom door several meters tall so that any Quirk's body fits through. The opening is set inside the homeroom, not in the lobby or the corridor. Class 1-A's door carries the class number in letters taller than a person; Class 1-B's is further down the same hall.

THE MOMENT: The PC has crossed the campus from Heights Alliance with a few minutes to spare and has just stepped through their homeroom's enormous door; the whole class is here, finding seats. In Class 1-A, Tenya Iida is lecturing Katsuki Bakugo for putting his feet on a desk while Bakugo tells him where to go, Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu are already seated, and Izuku Midoriya hovers in the doorway behind the PC, working up the nerve to come in. In Class 1-B, Itsuka Kendo is waving classmates to their seats and Neito Monoma is already talking about 1-A.

THE WHOLE CLASS IS HERE: every seat is filled and the opening shows the room full, naming each classmate at least once (arriving, sitting, talking, staring at the door). Class 1-A: Izuku Midoriya, Ochaco Uraraka, Katsuki Bakugo, Eijiro Kirishima, Shoto Todoroki, Tenya Iida, Momo Yaoyorozu, Kyoka Jiro, Tsuyu Asui, Fumikage Tokoyami, Denki Kaminari, Hanta Sero, Mina Ashido, Toru Hagakure, Mezo Shoji, Koji Koda, Mashirao Ojiro, Rikido Sato, Yuga Aoyama, Minoru Mineta. Class 1-B: Itsuka Kendo, Neito Monoma, Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, Ibara Shiozaki, Juzo Honenuki, Setsuna Tokage, Togaru Kamakiri, Hiryu Rin, Pony Tsunotori, Jurota Shishida, Yosetsu Awase, Sen Kaibara, Shihai Kuroiro, Kojiro Bondo, Kinoko Komori, Kosei Tsuburaba, Nirengeki Shoda, Yui Kodai, Reiko Yanagi, Manga Fukidashi.

WHO MAY APPEAR:
- Shota Aizawa: arrives in a yellow sleeping bag, finishes a pouch of jelly drink, times how long the class takes to fall silent, and wastes no words; gym uniforms, locker rooms, the field.
- Vlad King: loud and proud of 1-B, rounding them up for the ceremony.
- Izuku Midoriya: nervous, earnest, muttering; Ochaco Uraraka comes up behind him and recognizes him from the entrance exam.
- Katsuki Bakugo: feet on the desk, contempt for everyone; Tenya Iida: formal, chopping the air, insisting on school rules. If anyone asks where a classmate studied before, the answer is a high school: Iida graduated from Somei Private Academy, an elite private high school; Bakugo and Izuku from Aldera High School.
- Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu: already seated, quiet.
- Itsuka Kendo, Neito Monoma, Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu: 1-B classmates on the same floor.

OPENING HOOKS:
- U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-A): Izuku looks at the PC and asks, half to himself, whether this is really 1-A, and whether the shouting inside is who he thinks it is.
- U.A. Hero Course (Class 1-B): Kendo spots the PC in the hall and waves them toward 1-B's door before Vlad King starts roll call.
- Hero Family: a classmate recognizes the PC's family name from the hero rankings and says so loudly.
- Mutant: the PC's heteromorph body fits the tall door with room to spare, and someone inside says the door finally makes sense.
- Wealthy Family: a classmate notices something expensive the PC brought to class and asks about it.
- Default: the door slides open before the PC touches it, and every face in the room turns to the newcomers in the doorway.

RULES:
- Third person present tense. The opening is the walk into the main building and the moment at the classroom door; it never opens in the dorm and never replays move-in, room assignments or the first night.
- After roll call the day follows its plan: 1-A changes into gym uniforms in the locker rooms and goes to the athletics field; 1-B goes to the entrance ceremony.
- The PC's Quirk works exactly as their traits state; students use Quirks only in supervised training or self-defense.
- Nothing of the year has happened yet; no test, trial, vote or attack is promised or played early, and outcomes stay open.
- Canon classmates and teachers speak in their own voices from the first line; never a stand-in.
- End the opening on an open moment, not a question to the player.

THE FIRST DAYS: after today the week runs to routine: morning lessons in the homeroom (Present Mic's English, Cementoss's modern literature, Ectoplasm's mathematics, Nemuri Kayama's modern hero art history), lunch in Lunch Rush's Cafeteria, afternoon training on the grounds, evenings in the dorm lounge until curfew. Recovery Girl's Infirmary treats whatever training breaks.

WHAT THE PC CAN DO: pick a seat and a neighbor, introduce themself to anyone in the room, step into Iida and Bakugo's argument or stay out of it, or make room for Izuku in the doorway. Every choice is the player's.
First Day at U.A..firstQuest: Make a first impression at U.A. that is earned, not given: earn one classmate's trust and one rival's respect in the first week, and decide what kind of hero to be when nobody is watching.
First Day at U.A..questGenerationGuidance: Favor the first weeks of Hero Course life. Lessons and drills with Shota Aizawa or Vlad King judge control and judgment as much as raw power, and any expulsion threat is meant when it is made. Costume requests and fittings go through Power Loader's Development Studio; lectures come from Present Mic, Cementoss, Ectoplasm and Nemuri Kayama; injuries go to Recovery Girl. Class roles are settled by vote, never by contest. Friendships and rivalries form inside the class and across the 1-A and 1-B line: Monoma's needling, Kendo's chop, Bakugo's temper with Izuku. Evenings at Heights Alliance bring curfew, chores, study groups and homesickness; reporters wait at the gate since All Might joined the faculty. Canon events of the year arrive only when their causes are in place, never on a schedule, and the PC can change how they go. Stakes stay personal and local: standing in class, a teacher's attention, a reprimand, a rivalry, an injury.
